actions.label: Select Filter

actions.label: Add a matched Selects route

actions.label: Save deterministic Filter

actions.label: Save graph Export delivery template
actions.expected: The graph node's durable Export setup remains gated on an explicit folder grant and does not write during authoring.

actions.expected: The completed image is available to the authored local Transform node.

actions.label: Select Transform branch
actions.expected: Transform owns the local-media result and its downstream human and deterministic review sequence.

actions.expected: The visible branch includes one fake Evaluation call and its human Compare checkpoint before any permit is issued.

actions.label: Capture the authored Transform review branch
actions.expected: The blank-authored graph visibly joins local Transform, human Compare, fake Evaluation, deterministic Filter, and Join under one inspect-first branch plan.
actions.actual: Captured after the documented preceding action.

actions.label: Permit and start Transform review branch
actions.expected: The exact local Transform and deterministic evaluation branch is explicitly permitted without a real image or model request.

actions.label: Wait for the human Compare checkpoint
actions.expected: Job Center exposes the durable state transition created through the reviewed plan.

actions.expected: The transform result appears as a sealed human candidate.

actions.label: Select the transformed candidate
actions.expected: A person, not a model, makes the one-candidate Compare decision.

actions.label: Complete the human Compare checkpoint

actions.label: Return to Review for durable outputs

actions.label: Inspect deterministic Filter explanations

actions.label: Select the visible generated and transformed artifacts
actions.expected: Artifact Observatory selects actual document artifacts without a synthetic result set.

actions.label: Open Collections
actions.expected: Many-to-many membership is edited in the Artifact Observatory rather than by moving or deleting originals.

actions.label: Create Campaign selects collection
actions.expected: A durable collection is created through the ordinary Review workspace.

actions.label: Add selected artifacts to Campaign selects
actions.expected: Collection membership is non-destructive and remains visible beside the original artifacts.

actions.label: Open Export delivery setup
actions.expected: Export presents its explicit destination-grant gate and delivery controls without opening a native folder picker.

actions.label: Capture Review collection and direct Export grant gate
actions.expected: Generated artifacts are selected into Campaign selects while the Review-side direct Export dialog remains visibly blocked on its explicit folder choice; it is independent of the graph Export node and no native dialog or filesystem write occurs.
actions.actual: Captured after the documented preceding action.

actions.label: Close Export setup
actions.expected: The journey leaves delivery configuration without requesting a folder grant.

actions.label: T16-T19 visible practical slice
actions.expected: A blank-authored image route, local Transform, human Compare, deterministic Evaluate/Filter/Join, an isolated Batch grid/setup preview, graph delivery setup, and the Review-side collection/direct-export gate are visible in one offline journey.
actions.actual: The only provider-facing calls used Ether's opt-in local recovery simulation. Collection membership was added in Artifact Observatory, while the independent direct Export dialog stayed at its visible folder-grant gate; no real provider, native folder selection, or filesystem export was requested.
